observations.framing: Explicit UnitPixel or native display-header flag independently removes printer-default scaling. Square interior RGB becomes byte-identical to native direct control (max error zero). Bounds63 alone leaves initial mean RGB error9.15/max23. Corrected candidate uses display header, explicit pixel scale1 and inclusive63 bounds. Metafile natural bounds are64.9874 and reported65px; assay deliberately uses explicit64px playback and makes no natural-size claim.
observations.boundary_points: Four-point BoundaryPointData and explicit closed-line PathData square agree in all4096 pixels. Both native AddPolygon and point constructor record BoundaryPointData flags0 and agree bytewise. MS specification calls that representation cardinal; actual Windows recorder/playback establishes the bounded polygon compatibility observation.
observations.focus: Focus(0,0) matches default; (1,1) fills painted region with center color. Offcenter(20.5,24.5), focus(.3,.7) yields pure-center x17..31, consistent with scaling around configured center rather than bounding centroid. Endpoint support is observed Windows behavior beyond specification exclusive-endpoint prose.
observations.gamma_alpha: Native path opaque gamma is consistent with power2.2 (mean0.325/max1 versus quantized baseline over1920pixels); this is empirical, not a normative formula claim. Path and separately measured linear alpha interpolate associated color/alpha, then expose straight GetPixel RGB. Example native path at(20,24) normal=[163,0,88,95], gamma=[209,0,158,95]; native linear at(32,32) normal=[170,0,81,97], gamma=[212,0,152,97].
observations.compositing: SourceCopy on a larger target rectangle clears outside the path-gradient domain to transparent RGBA0; it does not preserve prior white there.
observations.nonconvex_and_outside_center: An outside center paints beyond the original polygon toward that center. A concave outside-kernel case paints part of the notch. Strict original-polygon containment would reject observed painted points. Farthest center-ray/fan interpretation is a mathematical inference to be validated by actual samples.
observations.partial_colors: Native SetSurroundColors with2 colors on4 vertices records4 colors by repeating the last. Authored wire with2 colors and authored excess5 colors both render; they must not be called structurally malformed merely from count!=vertexcount. Wire interpretation remains bound to recorded samples, not native setter expansion assumptions.
observations.wrap: Tile and flip modes paint beyond original boundary; Clamp does not, except outside-center/fan extension. Reflection pixel phase and multicolor interpolation differ from a naive unquantized radial formula; final painter must meet actual independent samples.

gouraud_integer_distance_model.kind: Original numeric reconstruction from actual independent native full-frame pixels; not copied Wine code
gouraud_integer_distance_model.algorithm: Coverage uses ceil intersections of original device edges. Endpoint color weights use absolute integer-distance counters on the major device axis, truncating the axis extent. The left span endpoint owns the carry between truncated extent and separately truncated endpoints. Horizontal color interpolation then uses integer covered endpoints. Uniform-color path shading retains its distinct analytic profile.
gouraud_integer_distance_model.limits: Numeric candidate proof only; the unchanged37-case production runtime checkpoint remains required. Positive subpixel major-axis length below1 is explicitly refused when its integer counter denominator is zero.

natural_canvas.policy: The inclusive round(frame extent at 96 dpi)+1 policy applies only to the top-level file Bitmap consumer. Embedded metafiles retain their prior logical frame extent and captured device DPI, consistently for inspection, live replay and isolated rasterization. WMF remains unchanged.
